create_AriaImageProcessor: create an AriaImageProcessor instance for preprocessing images for the Aria multimodal model
build_image_patches: build image patches from a high-resolution image using split_resolutions and a given patch size
resize_image_for_patching: resize an image to a target resolution while maintaining aspect ratio for patch-based processing
pad_image_to_target: pad an image to a target resolution with center-aligned padding for patch processing
get_image_patch_count: get the number of image patches for a given image height and width based on split resolutions
